name: Sekigahara (Japan)
description: A purple field charged at the centre with the Sekigahara town emblem in white: a ring open at the bottom above a stylised base, enclosing a stylised device.
history: Municipal flag of Sekigahara, a town in Gifu Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 16 March 1971.

features.role: Sekigahara town emblem — a ring open at the bottom above a stylised base, enclosing a stylised device
